text:
**My pick for a slim Qi2 power bank for iPhone 17 is the Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim).** I couldn't read the Android Central or WIRED reviews. Android Central came back truncated, and I didn't open WIRED or Macworld. This is based on 9to5Mac's roundup and the manufacturer pages.

**Anker Nano Power Bank 5K, $54.99** ([buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank))
- It is 0.34 in (8.6 mm) thick, weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), and holds 5,000 mAh.
- It charges iPhone 12 through 17 wirelessly at up to 15W.
- 9to5Mac picks it as the slim option with Qi2 speeds. It describes it as premium-feeling, cooler-running and close to Apple's form factor.
- Anker's page says it is both "Qi2-Certified" and "Qi2-Compatible", so the certification is unclear. The page also estimates only about 2,750–3,500 mAh is usable. That is roughly one partial iPhone charge.

**Other options**
- **UGREEN 10,000 mAh Qi2.2, $59.99:** It gives up to 25W wireless on iPhone 16 and newer, plus a built-in USB-C cable. It's bulkier, so it fits if you value capacity over slimness. 9to5Mac's roundup lists it, but I don't have a link.
- **Baseus 5,000 mAh, $24.99:** It's cheap and slim, but 9to5Mac lists it at only 7.5W wireless with no Qi2. It's the budget choice if you accept slower charging. I don't have a link for it.
- **LISEN P601, 5,000 mAh:** It is 0.38 in (9.6 mm) thick, weighs about 102–106 g, and lists Qi2 15W. Its page only offers wholesale (100-unit minimum) and has inconsistent specs, so I wouldn't count on buying one as a shopper. See the [LISEN page](https://lisenintl.com/products/p601-magsafe-power-bank/).
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52, 10,000 mAh Qi2.2, 45W:** Dealectric reports code AM52 takes $6 off, from $59.99 to $53.99, at Baseus's US store ([deal page](https://dealectric.com/lab/V0/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)). It has twice the capacity of the Anker for about the same price. I haven't confirmed its thickness or weight, so check that it's slim enough for you.

**Which to choose**
- **Thinnest and simplest:** the Anker.
- **More battery for the same money:** the Baseus PicoGo AM52 with the code, or the UGREEN.
- **Cheapest:** the Baseus 5K.
